rows.before: 高階電路板（HV）需要一臺LV電路組裝機。用它來合成基礎電路板（LV）和優質電路板（MV），可以大幅度提升效率。%n%n不過，所有電路組裝機都需要比同電壓其他機器更高等級的電路板。這意味著你必須用MV電路板，而不是現在一直在用的LV電路板。我知道你想要它，所以趕緊做出來吧！
rows.after: 高階電路（HV）需要一臺LV電路組裝機。用它來合成基礎電路（LV）和優質電路（MV），可以大幅度提升效率。%n%n不過，所有電路組裝機都需要比同電壓其他機器更高等級的電路。這意味著你必須用MV電路，而不是現在一直在用的LV電路。我知道你想要它，所以趕緊做出來吧！
rows.english:
Advanced (HV) circuits require an LV circuit assembling machine. Basic (LV) and Good (MV) ones can also be made much more efficiently with this machine.

However, all circuit assemblers need higher tier circuits than the other machines of their tier. This means you have to use MV circuits instead of the LV ones you've been using until now. I know you want it, so make it already!
rows.note: 僅修正已核對片語；Circuit 為電路，Circuit Board 才是電路板。副本的額外段落及版本差異保持原值。

rows.before: 強烈推薦做一個，因為使用電力進行研磨時，煤炭或蒸汽的利用效率會大大提高。%n%n到了HV階段，研磨機會解鎖一個額外槽位，隨後在EV和IV階段又會各增加一個槽位。第二個槽位可以產出更多副產物，非常§o非常§r有用。第三個槽位會產出礦石材質對應的粉。第四個槽位基本僅用於回收物品。%n%n[note]你也可以考慮使用蒸汽多方塊版本的研磨機。[/note]
rows.after: 強烈推薦做一個，因為使用電力進行研磨時，煤炭或蒸汽的利用效率會大大提高。%n%n到了HV階段，研磨機會解鎖一個額外槽位，隨後在EV和IV階段又會各增加一個槽位。第二個槽位可以產出更多副產物，非常§o非常§r有用。第三個槽位會產出礦石材質對應的粉。第四個槽位基本僅用於回收物品。%n%n[note]你也可以考慮使用蒸汽多方塊版本的研磨機。[/note]
rows.english:
It is highly recommended to get one of these, as the efficiency in terms of coal/steam used to macerate something is a lot better when using EU.

You get the first extra slot at HV, then +1 for EV and IV. The 2nd slot is for more byproducts, and is super §osuper§r useful. The 3rd slot is for ore block dusts. The 4th slot is basically only used for recycling stuff.

[note]You can also consider using the steam multiblock instead if you want.[/note]

rows.before: 無損的32 EU線纜怎麼樣？紅石合金是一種超導材料，可以無損傳輸你的能量。%n%n紅石合金是一種需要工業高爐才能冶煉的新合金。將紅石、矽粉和煤粉手動混合，或者使用攪拌機獲得更多產出。%n%n[note]別把它和紅色合金弄混了，那是ULV的材料。[/note]
rows.after: 無損的32 EU線纜怎麼樣？紅石合金是一種超導材料，可以無損傳輸你的能量。%n%n紅石合金是一種需要工業高爐才能冶煉的新合金。將紅石、矽粉和煤粉手動混合，或者使用攪拌機獲得更多產出。%n%n[note]別把它和紅色合金弄混了，那是ULV的材料。[/note]
rows.english:
How about lossless 32 EU cables? Redstone alloy is a superconductor and will transfer your energy without any loss.

Redstone Alloy is a new alloy which requires an EBF. Mix redstone, silicon and coal by hand, or in the mixer for a better result.

[note]Remember not to mix it up with Red Alloy, that's the ULV one.[/note]

rows.english:
A machine to get different byproducts out of your crushed or purified ore dust. It's useful for getting a bit of Gallium out of crushed Zinc Ore for your Diodes needed in good circuits.

When you have IC2 nuclear reactors and want to recycle your depleted fuel rods, it's the only way to do so.

If you can't produce the 2A of LV power for this machine right now, wait until you get to MV and use transformers to power an LV version.

In LV, you can obtain the same ore byproducts via different methods. The Thermal Centrifuge only becomes really important in HV when you can combine it with the HV macerator.

[warn]Sending MV power to an LV device, even if it uses more than 1A will cause an explosion, so don't do that.[/warn]

This element is used later on for Borosilicate Glass and fiber, but for now you can use it to make some volumetric flasks to hold precise amounts. This is handy for recipes that may only need a tiny amount of a substance, like 1L.

rows.before: 要是翻過NEI，你可能已經發現：電解黏土粉可以得到氧化鋁、二氧化矽、鈉和鋰粉，以及水——不過你大概已經直接銷燬了，對吧？在峽谷（Canyon）、平頂山（Mesa）、繁茂沙漠（Lush Desert）這類生物群系中，存在著大量的陶瓦，山脈（Mountains）上也能找到幾塊到幾十塊不等，把它們粉碎就能得到黏土粉。%n%n到了MV階段，獲取氧化鋁的途徑會多起來，等你到EV階段時，它基本上就不值什麼錢了。

rows.english:
If you looked through NEI you may have found out that electrolyzing clay dust will give you Alumina, Silicon Dioxide, Sodium, and Lithium dust. And water, but you're probably just voiding that already, right? There are plenty of stained clay blocks found in canyon, mesa, lush desert biomes or several to a couple dozen on mountains that can be pulverized to clay dust.

There are more ways to get alumina now that you're in MV, enough that it's basically worthless by the time you get to EV.

This machine is §overy§r important for your MV progression. If you find a biome with tons of Stained or Hardened Clay, you can process it here, plus some other machines, into Sodium, Lithium, Silicon, Aluminium and Oxygen!

rows.english:
A machine to get different byproducts out of your crushed or purified ore dust. It's useful for getting a bit of Gallium out of crushed Zinc Ore for your Diodes needed in good circuits.

When you have IC2 nuclear reactors and want to recycle your depleted fuel rods, it's the only way to do so.

If you can't produce the 2A of LV power for this machine right now, wait until you get to MV and use transformers to power an LV version.

In LV, you can obtain the same ore byproducts via different methods. The Thermal Centrifuge only becomes really important in HV when you can combine it with the HV macerator.

[warn]Sending MV power to an LV device, even if it uses more than 1A will cause an explosion, so don't do that.[/warn]
